records.title: Extrapolating Multilingual Understanding Models as Multilingual Generators
records.reason: The arXiv HTML was unavailable; the primary PDF was reviewed. The work adapts/extrapolates multilingual understanding models into multilingual generators and evaluates multilingual generation/transfer quality. It does not focus on compression, inference cost or faster decoding; relation to NAR sequence generation is weak and no concrete inference benefit is established.

records.title: Compressing And Debiasing Vision-Language Pre-Trained Models for Visual Question Answering
records.reason: The method compresses and debiases vision-language pretrained models for visual-question-answering and evaluates VQA accuracy/bias under compression. This is a transformer/VLM compression method, but the experiments are vision-language-specific and do not establish LLM generation-serving performance; linked low-bit transformer lineage is indirect.

records.title: Memory-Efficient Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models via Layer Pruning
records.reason: Layer pruning is applied to reduce memory for federated LLM fine-tuning, and experiments evaluate training memory/communication and task quality. The paper studies backpropagation/federated adaptation, not inference-time serving or generation latency. Its pruning mechanism could intersect model compression, but current evidence is training-only.

records.title: LLMs in Education: Evaluation GPT and BERT Models in Student Comment Classification
records.reason: The study fine-tunes and compares GPT/BERT-family models to classify student comments for anxiety/depression/neutral labels; full paper reports classification metrics (top models about 98.93% accuracy). The contribution is an application benchmark, not inference optimization, and the linked MiniLM compression title is not methodologically related.

records.title: GPTFootprint: Increasing Consumer Awareness of the Environmental Impacts of LLMs
records.reason: GPTFootprint is a browser-extension awareness intervention that estimates LLM water/energy per ChatGPT query and prompts breaks. A one-week study with nine participants increased awareness but had limited success reducing usage. It changes user behavior, not LLM inference compute/latency/memory/serving; linked green-inference relation is motivation-level only.
